xsd.validator: xmllint (libxml2) vs x3d-4.0.xsd from x3d_mcp + XSD patched: ComposedTexture3D children as a choice, not a sequence

gaps: XSD finding: x3d-4.0.xsd writes the texture field of a ComposedTexture3D as an xs:sequence of ImageTexture, PixelTexture, MovieTexture, ProtoInstance repeated, not an xs:choice, so the slices must come in fours in that order and two ImageTextures do not validate; the fixture is checked against the XSD with that sequence made a choice (the receipt says so); the image field of a PixelTexture3D takes decimal numbers only in the XSD (no 0x hex)
